title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E05 — Hunt for the Ark of the Covenant
Long-lost maps offer fresh clues in the hunt for the Ark of the Covenant; using the latest archaeological methods, experts retrace through steps through the Holy Land, Egypt and Ethiopia to make a game-changing discovery.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E07 — Egypt's Land of the Gods
New evidence from one of the world's oldest maps offers clues to a long-lost civilization of untold treasure, and this cutting-edge expedition might finally prove that this mysterious kingdom is the ancestral home of the ancient Egyptians.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E04 — Killing Meriwether Lewis
Meriwether Lewis was the man who teamed with William Clark to map the lands west of the Mississippi, but he died in mysterious circumstances; experts reveal a vast conspiracy that could prove that one of America's greatest explorers was murdered.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E01 — Ghost Ship of the Damned
Using a long-lost treasure map purporting to show the whereabouts of a missing ship buried with gold and silver in the California desert, a team of experts uses the new evidence to get closer to a game-changing discovery.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E02 — Fire in the Cockpit
Some believe the fire on Apollo One that killed three astronauts was a top-secret cover-up, and a team of experts investigates if this disaster was a tragic accident or part of a conspiracy to fake the moon landing.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E01 — NASA Nazi Conspiracy
A team of experts investigates if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncovers a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space program.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E05 — CIA's Secret Space War
Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.

description:

Custom running shoes; axes; racing karts; animatronics.

S26 E13 — Channel Signs; Wetsuits; Aluminum Aircraft
More everyday items go under the microscope; an insight into how objects like channel signs and wetsuits are made, and what is the construction behind aluminium aircraft.

description:
S15 E01 — Kelp Caviar; Luxury Sailboats; Dental Crowns
Exploring the production processes for kelp caviar, luxury sailboats, dental crowns and high-performance engines.

title: How It's Made
description:
S15 E02 — Leather Briefcases; Crop Dusters; Corn Whiskey
Leather briefcases; crop-dusters; corn whiskey; drag-racing clutches.

title: How It's Made
description:
S15 E03 — Train Rails; Desalinated Water; Racing Wheelchairs
Follow the manufacturing processes behind train rails, desalinated water, racing wheelchairs and parquetry flooring.

title: How It's Made
description:
S15 E04 — Flight Simulators; Traditional Bookbinding; Greenhouse Tomatoes
Following the manufacturing processes behind flight simulators, traditional bookbinding, greenhouse tomatoes and hurricane-proof shutters.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E06 — War of the Galaxies
Galaxies are locked in continual combat across the universe, and the Milky Way will face its biggest opponent ever, the Andromeda Galaxy, in a titanic and deadly struggle that could create a new and unrecognizable super galaxy.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E02 — Mission to a Comet
The Rosetta mission is a groundbreaking expedition to land on a comet for the very first time; special access reveals what this cutting-edge journey discovers and how these mysterious objects help create life on Earth.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E04 — Aliens of the Microcosmos
The hidden kingdom of microscopic alien organisms shapes the universe as much as galaxies, stars, and planets; new discoveries reveal how bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms built life on Earth and influence humanity's future in the cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E09 — Birth of the Monster Black Holes
New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E03 — Secrets of the Sun
A brand-new NASA mission to the sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the sun's atmosphere, its findings challenge everything known about this strange place.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E11 — Mystery of Alien Worlds
An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

title: Artemis II: To the Moon and Back
description: NASA sends Americans back to the Moon for the first time in over 50 years and in a new spacecraft; from mission prep to splashdown on Earth, join the Artemis II crew on this 10-day voyage of exploration.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

description:
Shadow Deathstar
Astronaut Leroy Chiao's spacewalk is interrupted by bright lights flying past; a flying saucer is photographed from the Apollo.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E02 — Hindenburg Mystery
Adam and Jamie try to solve one of aeronautics' biggest puzzles; Kari, Tory and Grant face some of nature's natural-born killers.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E12 — Big Rig Myths
Adam and Jamie test how dangerous an exploding truck tire can be.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E04 — Underwater Car
Adam and Jamie try to escape a car submerged in water.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E04 — How Black Holes Made Us
Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light, and building the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E03 — The Interstellar Mysteries
Discoveries about interstellar space, the space between the universe's stars, reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought, but filled with weird objects and strange phenomena that might hold the darkest secrets of the cosmos.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E04 — Secret History of James Bond
James Bond is one of the famous characters in history, and new discoveries reveal there might be a secret truth behind this famous figure; experts team up with a former spy to separate fact from fiction and reveal the secrets of modern espionage.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E03 — Hunt for Nazi Treasure
Experts investigate the fate of billions of dollars in gold and artwork that Adolf Hitler stole during World War II; using brand-new discoveries, the location of the missing Nazi treasure could be located.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E02 — Ghosts of the Berlin Wall
Shocking secrets were revealed when the Berlin Wall finally came down.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E05 — The Dead Sea Scrolls Conspiracy
Experts investigate if there's a conspiracy surrounding the Dead Sea Scrolls, the ancient texts that the Vatican kept top-secret for decades, which could reveal the location of a mysterious tunnel holding billions of dollars of treasure.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E01 — Secret History of Jesus
New investigations into the mysterious life of Jesus Christ reveal the truth behind this history-changing figure; using the latest evidence, experts try to separate fact from fiction.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E06 — Secret Societies: Mystery and Conspiracy
Experts investigate if there's any truth to conspiracy theories that allege secret societies control the course of world history from behind the scenes, and if true, new discoveries might finally reveal the extent of their global domination.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E01 — Highest Highs, Lowest Lows
Josh Gates recounts the death-defying exploits of Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay, who summit Mount Everest; two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific; a pilot skydives from the edge of space.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E02 — Polar Extremes
Josh Gates tackles history's most chilling polar adventures, including Robert Peary and Matthew Henson's brave push to the North Pole as well as Ernest Shackleton's epic survival in Antarctic ice.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E03 — The Race to Space
Josh Gates boldly explores members' most heart-pounding journeys into space; Apollo 13 astronauts fight to bring their crippled spacecraft 238,000 miles back to Earth and futuristic SpaceShipOne could give others a chance to travel to space.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E04 — Wild Rides
Josh Gates explores daring journeys, including the Kon-Tiki balsa raft crossing the Pacific, NASA's lunar rover making tracks on the moon and an airplane flying around the world without the use of fuel.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E05 — Monsters and Myths
Josh recounts a Himalayan mission to find the yeti and a filmmaker's pursuit of the dangerous elephant king; the starving crew of an Antarctic expedition makes difficult choices to survive.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E06 — Explorer's Club at the Movies
Josh Gates explores how club members' swashbuckling exploits inspired Hollywood; a bullwhip-cracking archaeologist may be the real-life Indiana Jones; a Nazi mountaineer's life-changing "Seven Years in Tibet" became a Brad Pitt star turn.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E06 — Dog Myths
Adam and Jamie aim to dispel the myth that one can't teach an old dog new tricks; they make an attempt to teach untrained middle-aged Huskies.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E05 — Speed Cameras
Adam and Jamie push the limits when it comes to speed; they take on speed cameras in an action-packed adventure.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E07 — More Myths Reopened
Jamie and Adam revisit the most controversial myths; they repeat them to see if their original answer was genuine.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E05 — Secret World of Nebulas
Nebulas are the strange structures of cosmic gas and dust where stars are born and die, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Towie Ball
Containing intricately carved concentric circles, the Towie Ball is one of the finest Neolithic stoneworks ever discovered; using cutting-edge imaging technology, experts investigate the purpose behind this 5,000-year-old black stone mystery.

title: Strangest Things
description:
Phineas Gage's Skull
The shattered skull of a 19th century railway worker is now one of the most astonishing objects in the history of medical science; experts explore this traumatic injury to reveal how it changed the field of neuroscience.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Mask of Agamemnon
Investigating whether a gold death mask is the face of a king who fought in the Trojan Wars; three ancient chalk carvings could be the secret to constructing Stonehenge; how a printing plate from the UK Treasury ended up in an Austrian lake.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Psychograph
Investigating whether a machine can read personalities; an ancient golden mask painted with human blood; a cursed chicken pot.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Assassination Sphere
A minuscule metal sphere containing two microscopic holes could be the smallest murder weapon in history; experts explore how this tiny object is linked to one of the most bizarre true crime cases of the 20th century.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Dixon Relics
A stone sphere, a hook and five fragments of wood are the only objects ever discovered inside the Great Pyramid of Giza; experts investigate if they can explain the mysteries behind the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Jericho Head
In 1953, a team of archaeologists uncovers a bizarre, plastered human skull in the ancient city of Jericho; experts investigate the mysterious purpose and identity behind this 9,000-year-old clay-covered artifact.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E07 — Possessed by an Alien
When footage reveals a man's leg taking on a life of its own, it appears that something alien is trying to burst free; cutting-edge science investigates what explains this strange possession, and what it takes to exorcise the invader inside.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E08 — Revenge of the Monster Wolf
Footage of a wolf-like creature in the remote wilderness of northern Canada could be evidence of a dire wolf, a prehistoric beast that went extinct at the end of the last Ice Age; experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate if it has returned.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E09 — Alien in Paradise
A bizarre, tentacled black mass emerges from the seas on an island in the Caribbean, and on-lookers are horrified as it writhes ashore; experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate the origin of this alien invader.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E10 — Mystery of the Face Parasite
A man sees a doctor complaining of agonizing facial pain, and when they investigate, they discover a strange parasitic species living deep in the man's nose; footage of the grisly encounter reveals what happened next.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E01 — Haunting on Devil Road
Two young men capture a ghostly figure that begins chasing them on a deserted road in the mountains of Jordan; experts investigate and uncover local tales of black magic practitioners and demonic entities with supernatural powers.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E02 — Conjuring of Demons
A young woman captures a doll that mysteriously comes to life inside a closet as she house sits alone in Dallas; experts investigate and reveal terrifying accounts of haunted dolls possessed by demonic souls.

Adam and Jamie test if a truck filled with birds becomes lighter when the birds take flight.

title: MythBusters

S05 E08 — Voice Flame Extinguisher
Adam and Jamie test whether it is possible to put out a fire using only a voice.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E10 — Walking on Water
Jamie and Adam find out if ninjas can run on water, as they join a ninjutsu master and try their luck at aquatic agility.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E02 — When Supernovas Strike
Supernovas are the violent death of giant stars, and new discoveries reveal that these cataclysmic events create the elements that are essential to all life in the universe.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E08 — Chemical Plant Calamity
An explosion at a chemical plant in New Jersey kills five workers and unleashes a torrent of black smoke into the morning sky; an investigation reveals how a small amount of water led to this fatal manufacturing catastrophe.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
The Bronx Sinkhole
There's shock in the Bronx, as a vast sinkhole swallows a van.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E05 — Nebraska Bomb Cyclone
An aging dam in Nebraska is overcome by flooding after the area is hit with a devastating bomb cyclone; an investigation reveals that massive chunks of ice unleashed by the superstorm played a critical role in the failure of the old structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E02 — Miami's Condo Catastrophe
Catastrophe strikes Miami, Fla., as a 13-story condominium tower collapses with deadly debris; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an uncontrolled method of demolition that led to catastrophic failure.
